name: hazel_weir_velocity_procedural_graph_v2
description: Optimized Procedural Graph featuring balanced 15-16 plot expansion, flexible immediate-watering to prevent regrowth stalls, duration-gated Town Shop arbitrage, and moderated 0.80x liquidation floors.

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Computes net available cash, shed fill percentage, wage liability, active shop contract demand, and oracle price drop signals across market commodities.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Protects payroll for all active hired hands. Enforces dynamic cash reserve locks and triggers pre-midnight surplus liquidation to prevent the 0-hand bankruptcy cascade.

nodes.name: Town Shop Demand Arbitrage
nodes.description: Fulfills active town shop contracts for 2.0x-3.5x premiums. Procures exact seed quantities for active shop demands with strict duration gating to avoid stranded crops.

nodes.name: Capital Velocity & Liquidation
nodes.description: Executes continuous batch liquidations of uncontracted surplus inventory at favorable market prices, unlocking fluid cash for reinvestment and preventing idle physical stock.

nodes.name: Oracle Opponent Front-Run
nodes.description: Reads 96-step TTM forecast to dump sensitive commodities immediately before opponent market gluts collapse prices, using moderated glut thresholds.

nodes.name: Capital Reinvestment & Yield Scaling
nodes.description: Reinvests surplus cash into workforce scaling (up to 11 hands), moderated land expansion (15-16 plots max), and hyper-fertilized recurring cash crops (Strawberries) for maximum multi-harvest yield compounding.

nodes.name: Routine Farm & Workforce Execution
nodes.description: Executes field routines with cluster harvesting. Prioritizes immediate watering after harvest to eliminate growth-pausing dry intervals without enforcing rigid atomic locks.

attributes.guidance: Cancel non-essential purchases; schedule worker harvest drop-offs before hour 21; enforce emergency liquidation of non-feed, non-contract inventory at hour >= 20 to guarantee payroll.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (n_animals * 3); never liquidate crops committed to active town shop delivery.

attributes.condition: has_unlocked_shops and (shop_deliverable_inventory > 0 or (net_available_cash >= 200.0 and active_shop_demand > 0)) and day <= 28
attributes.guidance: Allocate market slots to deliver exact matching inventory to town shops for premium. Buy shop seeds only if contract_remaining_steps >= crop_growth_steps + 2 AND current_day + crop_growth_days <= 28. Prohibit unfertilized single-harvest shop crops unless premium > 3.0x base price.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not hoard inventory speculatively for future unrevealed contracts; instantly release uncontracted surplus to open-market liquidation. Do not buy shop seeds if net cash falls below 1.5x midnight payroll.

attributes.guidance: Execute batch sales (8-10 units) of unreserved surplus when market price >= 0.88 * base_price. Relax price floor to 0.80 * base_price if shed_used >= 70. Maintain capital velocity without deep price discounting.
attributes.pitfalls: Never liquidate exact item quotas reserved for active town shop contracts. Set dynamic livestock feed reserves strictly to n_animals * 3 (0 if no animals).

attributes.guidance: Preempt lowest-margin open orders; execute rapid batch liquidations of vulnerable commodities while current market price remains favorable (> 0.80 * base_price) before opponent dumping collapses market prices.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not dump into already collapsed sub-0.60 base price markets unless shed overflow is imminent; do not front-run commodities committed to active town shop contracts.

attributes.condition: net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.5 + 150.0 and (hired_hands < 11 or uncultivated_plots > 0 or has_fertilizer_deficit) and day <= 24
attributes.guidance: Scale workforce to 11 hands. Gate contiguous land expansion to 15-16 plots when hands >= 8, cash > 2.0x payroll + plot cost, and day <= 15. Maintain hyper-fertilized Strawberries as the exclusive compounding engine through Day 23. Restrict fast-crop Carrots strictly to Day 24+ on vacant plots.
attributes.pitfalls: Never expand land beyond 16 plots or after Day 15. Never overwrite active perennial Strawberry plots. Ensure persistent fertilizer procurement for all Strawberry plots.

attributes.guidance: Dispatch hands using cluster harvesting. Workers must harvest adjacent ready plots up to inventory capacity. Water dry crops immediately after harvest to prevent regrowth stalls, but avoid rigid atomic locks that freeze workers without water. Restrict shed transit to saturated inventory or step 714.
attributes.pitfalls: Never deprioritize watering below shed transit, as dry plots halt growth. Do not allow 1-crop transit cycles that waste worker steps. Ensure hands never idle while unharvested crops or dry plots remain.
